notes: The public demo, not the tracker. Slug is congress-demo, not congress: /opt/sites/_vhosts/congress.conf is the production congress.noeinsolutions.com vhost and a slug of congress would overwrite it. Two containers: web (nginx serving the React build, the only one on the edge network) proxies /api to api (FastAPI on the frozen snapshot, DEMO_MODE on, on an internal network with no route out). The snapshot is unpacked into a tmpfs at start, so every restart serves the committed fixture. This replaces deploy/congress-demo-api.service, which ran the same process on the host beside the live API; a container needs no host checkout and cannot reach the live database at all. APP_SESSION_SECRET lives in /opt/sites/congress-demo/.env on the server. Deploy from the repo root with: bash ~/.claude/skills/hetzner-site/bin/site-deploy.sh (the root deploy.sh is the private tracker's wrapper, not this).
